metadata.title: Bullish Stock Is Set to Win Whatever Happens to Crypto Law, Analyst Says<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Bullish Stock Is Set to Win Whatever Happens to Crypto Law, Analyst Says
Macroeconomic jitters have weighed on the cryptocurrency market recently, but a Wall Street analyst still sees big potential in Bullish, a top exchange operator.
